description: This file defines logging configuration and utility functions for JSON logging, exception handling, and log level management within a Python project related to 'litellm'. It includes custom JSON formatter, setup for exception handlers, and functions to toggle debug and JSON logging states.

classes.name: JsonFormatter
classes.description: Custom logging formatter that outputs logs in JSON format with timestamp, message, level, and optional stacktrace.

methods.name: _setup_json_exception_handlers
methods.description: Sets up exception handlers for uncaught exceptions and asyncio exceptions to log errors in JSON format.

methods.name: _initialize_loggers_with_handler
methods.description: Initializes all loggers with a specified handler, clearing existing handlers and preventing propagation.

methods.name: _turn_on_json
methods.description: Enables JSON logging across all loggers with JSON formatter and exception handlers.

methods.name: _turn_on_debug
methods.description: Sets the verbose loggers to DEBUG level for detailed logging.

methods.name: _disable_debugging
methods.description: Disables verbose logging by setting loggers to disabled.

methods.name: _enable_debugging
methods.description: Enables verbose logging by setting loggers to active.

methods.name: print_verbose
methods.description: Prints a statement if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: _is_debugging_on
methods.description: Returns True if debugging is currently enabled.
